title: “Plain Vanilla” Electric Alarm Clock Has Battery Backup System
text:
“Plain Vanilla” Electric Alarm Clock Has Battery Backup System. Old habits die hard, so I like to have an electric alarm clock--one with an easy-to-set alarm--on my bedside table. Ths AMAZONBASICS DIGITAL ALARM CLOCK (with Large 1.4-Inch Display) satisfies that need. However, it seems expensive (about $18 on Amazon) for what it is--a simple electric alarm clock with a single beeper alarm.

The alarm clock does have one nice “extra” feature. It has a battery backup system that keeps the clock going during a power outage so that your alarm still wakes you up on time. The backup system requires a 9V battery (NOT included).

For a couple of dollars more (about $20 on Amazon), you can get an [[ASIN:B07DQYFCXM AmazonBasics Digital Clock Radio (FM only)]]. This alarm clock has two separate alarms, a battery backup system, an FM radio, and a USB charging port. The built-in radio speaker is pretty bad, but you can use the beeper alarm option instead. I think that the clock radio with two alarms is a better choice than this “plain vanilla” digital alarm clock.
